items.notes: 08 §8: the town whose team had been gone five years and whose stadium had grown over.

body: There is a notice on the door with the league's name at the top and a date in the middle of it.
Everything they owe everyone goes with it. Somebody asks about the arrears and is told there is nobody left to ask.
The kit man is loading the van because the van belongs to him.

choices.outcome_text: It takes forty minutes. Vitya finds two balls behind the lockers and puts one in your bag.
The gate is padlocked by the time you reach it, so you go out the way the crowd goes out.
